population: Signal exits strictly before their archived 40-bar endpoint.
data: Read only referenced enriched partitions after verifying size and mtime_ns before and after reading; these references are not immutable content snapshots.
window: Strictly after exit date through the archived horizon end date. Exclude exit-day high/low because fill time versus intraday extrema is not resolved.
measure: Minimum subsequent low relative to recorded exit fill; first subsequent close above that fill; first daily low at or below 90 percent of that fill. Same-bar touches have unknown intraday ordering.
threshold: 10 percent is a descriptive severity label, not a proposed stop or searched parameter.
scope: Outcome diagnostics only, no strategy changes, no temporal testing, no promotion.
